name: esp32_adc_oneshot_read
description: adc/oneshot_read on the ESP32: ADC1's channels 4 and 5 and ADC2's channel 0 at 12 dB, one read a second each, with the eFuse's Vref calibration (ESP-IDF's line fitting, Vref 1170 mV on this chip). The model's transfer is that fitted line, so the raw codes are its inverse and the calibrated voltages the sources' within a millivolt. ADC1 at 12 dB: a = 1170 x 196602 / 4096 = 56158, b = 142 mV, so 1.1 V is (1100 - 142) x 65536 / 56158 = 1118 and 2.2 V 2402; ADC2: a = 56320, b = 128 mV, so 0.5 V is 433.
